prompts.portals: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE production game sprite atlas, 3 columns by 2 rows of equal square cells, transparent background. Create SIX separate isolated lavish fantasy cave portal environment sprites for a premium 2.5D football social game. All are frontal three-quarter elevated camera, centered in their own cell with empty transparent gutters and fully visible base. First row: volcanic RED/ORANGE cave, orange-crimson cave, magenta-crimson cave. Second row: electric royal BLUE cave, luminous CYAN cave, luminous PURPLE cave. The RED/ORANGE first cave is the hero. Each is a natural sculpted rocky grotto arch, intricate stone texture, moss, ferns, flowering plants, warm golden lanterns, small stone entrance steps, bright magical swirling portal and deep dark interior. A wide ornate dark walnut wooden signboard over the cave entrance must be BLANK, no writing. Round crest on top is BLANK. Style: richly detailed polished stylized 3D game render, painterly hand-crafted fantasy theme park, saturated colors, warm sunlight from upper left, beautiful volumetric emissive glow, ambient occlusion, convincing dimensional stone, crisp antialiased edges. Like a high-end animated fantasy game not flat vector. Each individual sprite should fill 88% of its square cell. No humans, no actual football club logos, no typography, no UI, no floor/background except tiny base contact shadow. Exact regular 3x2 grid, no overlaps between cells. Landscape 1536x1024.
